title: UK equity financial statement API: annual and half-year figures for 1,000 London-listed companies
author: selfsideUK
selftext:
I run Selfside, a UK equity research site, and this is its data API. It serves income statements, balance sheets and cash flows for about 1,000 London-listed companies, annual and half-year.

A free account covers every company and includes 100 statement queries. Generate a key here: [https://selfside.co.uk/account/api](https://selfside.co.uk/account/api)

This is a V0 preview, with a stable release coming soon. The V1 release will have more data, like intra-year share counts, ownership data, derived metrics, and point-in-time queries to eliminate look-ahead bias during modelling.

To see a response before signing up, the token demo works for HSBC (HSBA), BAE Systems (BA) and Rolls-Royce (RR):

curl "[https://selfside.co.uk/api/v0/statements/HSBA:income\_statement:annual:2025-12-31?api\_token=demo](https://selfside.co.uk/api/v0/statements/HSBA:income_statement:annual:2025-12-31?api_token=demo)"

More product information and some benchmarks and examples be found at: [https://selfside.co.uk/data](https://selfside.co.uk/data)

If anyone is interested in UK equity market data and/or the stable release please reach out.
